name: d-praeira
description: E-commerce de moda praia casual - d' Praieira (monorepo: Next.js + NestJS + Prisma/SQLite)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
